units.source_text: 白居易《八月十五夜禁中独直对月忆元九》诗云：“

en.t: Bai Juyi's poem “On the Fifteenth Night of the Eighth Month, Alone on Duty in the Palace, Facing the Moon and Remembering Yuan Jiu” says:

units.source_text: 银台金阙夕沉沉，独宿相思在翰林。

en.t: The silver terraces and golden palace gates sink into the deepening dusk; sleeping alone in the Hanlin Academy, I am filled with longing.

units.source_text: 三五夜中新月色，二千里外故人心。

en.t: On this fifteenth night, the moonlight is fresh and clear; two thousand li away, an old friend's heart must be thinking of me.

units.source_text: 渚宫东面烟波冷，浴殿西头钟漏深。

en.t: East of the waterside palace, misty waves are cold; west of the bathing hall, the bells and water clock sound late into the night.

units.source_text: 犹恐清光不同见，江陵卑湿足秋阴。”

en.t: Still I fear that we may not be seeing the same pure light, for Jiangling is low and damp, and full of autumn gloom.”
